definitions: A common phrase used by programmers as a simple test of a new programming language or system.
A traditional first program in many programming courses, designed to output the text 'Hello, World!' to the console or screen.
examples: The first thing I did when learning Python was write a 'hello world' program.
Every new framework seems to have its own 'hello world' tutorial.
It's just a 'hello world' app, nothing complex yet.
